description: This file defines the PresignUrlMiddleware class used within the AWS SDK for PHP to manage presigned URLs for service operations requiring temporary URL authentication.

classes.name: PresignUrlMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for generating presigned URLs for AWS service commands that require temporary access URLs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes middleware with options including operations, service name, presign parameter, and other configurations.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware factory for wrapping an AWS client with presigning capabilities.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles middleware invocation, appends presigned URLs to commands if applicable, and delegates to the next handler.

methods.name: createPresignedUrl
methods.description: Private method that generates a presigned URL for a given command using AWS Signature V4 signer, endpoint resolution, and current request parameters.
